medications.nice_justification: NG28 recommends Metformin as core therapy; eGFR ≥ 30 mL/min/1.73 m² permits full dosing

medications.purpose: Improve glycaemic control and provide renal/cardiovascular protection
medications.nice_justification: NG28 (2024 update) recommends Metformin + SGLT2i as first‑line for all adults with T2DM and eGFR ≥ 30

medications.dose: 2.5 mg orally once daily, titrate every 2 weeks to target BP <130/80 mmHg (max 10 mg)
medications.nice_justification: NG203 recommends ACE‑I as first‑line antihypertensive in CKD

medications.dose: 20 mg orally once daily in the evening
medications.purpose: Cardiovascular risk reduction in diabetes and CKD
medications.nice_justification: CG181/NG203 advise statin for all CKD patients or QRISK ≥ 10 %

interactions_checked.interaction: Additive risk of volume depletion and hypotension, especially if patient is volume‑depleted
interactions_checked.action: Monitor blood pressure, electrolytes and renal function; advise adequate hydration
Check blood pressure at follow‑up; no dose change required

assumptions_warnings: QRISK score not provided – assumed ≥10 % given age, obesity, CKD and hypertension
Lipid profile not available – statin started per CKD risk guidance
Urine albumin‑creatinine ratio (ACR) not recorded – ACE‑I initiated for hypertension and renal protection
Serum potassium and baseline LFTs not documented – will obtain before starting ramipril and atorvastatin
Pregnancy status unknown – assumed not pregnant; will confirm contraception use
Allergy history not documented – will verify no sulfonamide, ACE‑I or statin allergy
treatment_summary: Increase Metformin XR to 500 mg BID, add dapagliflozin 10 mg daily, start ramipril 2.5 mg daily (titrate to BP target), and initiate atorvastatin 20 mg nightly. These interventions follow NICE NG28 and NG203 for T2DM with CKD stage 2 and hypertension, providing glycaemic control, renal protection, and cardiovascular risk reduction. Monitor BP, renal function, electrolytes, and lipids; review in 3 months and then annually.
